author: Unity
description:
In this tutorial, you’ll learn to use Unity Studio's own visual scripting system, called Logic, which allows you to create interactive 3D experiences without writing any code. 

Unity Studio is a web-based, no-code editor designed for industries like manufacturing, automotive, healthcare, architecture, and more to build and share interactive 3D applications fast. Import CAD, BIM, or 3D data and bring ideas to life in minutes.

Learn more about Unity Studio: https://on.unity.com/unitystudio

For assistance or questions, please check out our documentation for helpful articles and guides: https://on.unity.com/StudioDocumentation

If you still need help, contact our support team at: 
unitystudio-support@unity3d.com
title: Unity Studio - Creating Logic
